summary: The diff (3 dependency-cruiser rule configs for ddd/clean-architecture/enterprise-architecture, the pipeline script that runs them against the 3 real repos, the AI-Review drift-check registration script, the bounded-context map, and the phase-4 close-out) is architecturally sound, follows the existing Phase 1-3 conventions (shared audit_findings/audit_runs schema, parameterized SQL, fcntl write-lock, pinned dependency-cruiser version, no shell=True/command-injection risk, no .github/workflows/** touched), and I independently verified the headline finding-counts in the close-out evidence block (ddd=4, clean-architecture=0, enterprise-architecture=11 across compliance-tracker/projexa/veda-advisors) against the live superboss-register.sqlite audit_findings table and they match exactly. However, I found a real correctness bug that falsifies a specific claim in the same evidence block: in audit_pipeline_architecture.py's main() (around line 345), the per-repo/per-domain audit_runs.new_findings column is written as sum(1 for r in domain_records) -- i.e. it always equals total_findings -- instead of using the true new-vs-existing delta that upsert_findings() already computes globally. I confirmed this concretely: querying audit_findings for the ddd/compliance-tracker rows shows first_seen_ts from the first pipeline run and last_seen_ts from a second run 38 seconds later (i.e. these were correctly recognized as pre-existing, not new), yet the audit_runs row for that second run still records new_findings=4, not 0. This directly contradicts the close-out text's explicit claim that '[e]very pipeline re-run confirmed idempotent (0 new_findings on an unchanged target...)' -- a specific, checkable claim now permanently written into AUDITOR_ENGINE_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml (a governance record) that is false per the very audit_runs table it cites as evidence. Since this task's entire purpose is producing trustworthy audit records and the close-out convention explicitly tells future phases to follow this same pattern, I'm rejecting rather than approving-with-a-note, so the metrics bug gets fixed and the close-out evidence text corrected before this becomes the template other domains copy.
issues: audit_pipeline_architecture.py ~line 345: audit_runs.new_findings is computed as sum(1 for r in domain_records) (== len(domain_records) == total_findings) instead of the true count of newly-inserted findings for that repo/domain; upsert_findings() already computes the correct global new_count but it is never broken down per repo/domain and used here

AUDITOR_ENGINE_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml's phase-4 close-out evidence block states 'Every pipeline re-run confirmed idempotent (0 new_findings on an unchanged target...)' -- verified false against the live audit_runs table (second run on unchanged findings shows new_findings=4, not 0) because it inherits the bug above; this record should be regenerated after the fix, not left as-is
